Administering KoldFusion Server

Version Info

The Version Information page tells you exactly what you are running and how busy it is. Nothing here can be changed. It is the page to print out before you call Allair technical support.

Go there: Open the Version Info page (or inside the frameset)

Product information

Row Shows
Server Product KoldFusion Server
Version The version number, also available as Server.ColdFusion.ProductVersion
Edition Enterprise
Serial Number The serial number recorded at installation
Operating System, OS Version, Additional Information, Build Number Details of the host machine, from the Server.OS structure

Server Statistics

  • Server started: when the server last started (or restarted) and how long it has been up.
  • Page requests served: the number of CFML requests since then.
  • Running / queued / timed out: requests running right now, requests waiting for a free slot (see "Limit simultaneous requests" on the Server Settings page) and requests flagged as unresponsive.
  • Cached templates / queries: what the Caching page manages.
  • Install directory, Web root and Listening on: the paths and the address:port the server uses, plus its process ID.

Active Applications and Sessions

A list of every application and session currently in memory, with the number of variables each holds and when it was last used. It is a quick way to see whether your session timeouts behave the way you expect.

Note  If "queued" is often above zero, raise the simultaneous request limit or find the slow page (see Logging Settings, "Log Slow Pages").
